blockers.finding: After a child the recorder checks runtime/HEAD/worktree but omits branch, remote and committed source guard. The last run can therefore produce final success without a complete post-state check. git ls-remote and other check_output calls have no timeout.
blockers.minimal_repair: Add bounded git timeouts. Invoke full state(before) and compare identity after each command, catching exceptions into the execution record and stopping on failure.

blockers.finding: Child launch, runtime snapshot, or post-git exceptions can escape before execution.json. Only the start record and raw files survive, without a closed completion/unknown-state receipt or stopped summary.
blockers.minimal_repair: Wrap launch and post-state operations separately; retain launch failure/timeout, return code, elapsed time, log hashes and runtime-after when available. Use null for unverified state, write execution.json before raising or stopping, and emit only a fixed stopped code. Preserve original logs and prohibit run 2 after any such failure.

blockers.finding: The recorder prints all exposure keys/values and first_rejection_stage/same_entry_local_checks without exact shapes/types or allowed-value validation. It validates only selected exposure fields; arbitrary extra keys or unsupported stage strings would be forwarded. Source/capture/prerequisite/profile checks are incomplete.
blockers.minimal_repair: Before printing, require exact report and exposure key sets from the frozen base; profile PROFILE, synthetic_fixture False, fixed capture identity and prerequisite digest/producer, exact observed bytes/md5/sha256 types/shape, STAGES and LOCAL_SCOPES membership, nonempty closed primary categories with reason equal to the first, and categories equal primary plus supplementary. Require bool exposure types, fixed false scientific/disclosure flags, strict int zero fits/splits, empty decompressed members and no close error. Forward only this validated fixed projection.

confirmed_nonblockers: Current field names members_decompressed and xml_decoded match the inherited header base.
The only child operations are two fixed diagnose --run 1/2 commands.
Expected subprocess success code 2 agrees with diagnostic.main, which always returns 2.
Canonical stdout is compared byte-for-byte to the fixed public receipt and final two reports must match.
Raw child stderr is stored privately and is not intentionally printed; current public projection needs the closed-shape repair above.
subprocess.run timeout kills and reaps the direct diagnostic child; process groups are not a blocker for this fixed command.
scope: Static recorder/source contract review only. No actual source operations or tracked edits. Repairs require a new source hash and static rebind before invocation.
